You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (25.6 s) ===
[0.0-2.4] HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Stern): "No one will bow yet!"
[2.4-4.6] SCREEN: Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.
[4.6-12.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.
[4.8-12.6] ACTION: The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.
[4.8-12.7] HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe): "This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union."
[CUT]
[12.8-16.8] HIGH PRIEST (Unyielding, Condemning): "You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife."
[17.0-21.3] SCREEN: Close-up two-shot of Juliana gasping in terror, clutching Alexander's hand tightly as Alexander glares at the Priest.
[17.3-21.0] ACTION: Juliana looks up at Alexander in sudden panic, her fingers gripping his leather-gloved hand.
[21.3-25.6] SCREEN: Slow push-in close-up on Catherine beneath her veil, her initial despair morphing into a cold, venomous, triumphant smile as the episode cuts.
[21.8-25.6] ACTION: Catherine raises her chin, a vindictive smirk spreading across her lips as she realizes her rival's claim has just been torn to pieces.
